# getremotejobsnow.com

> A remote job board that sorts every listing by where you can actually work from: anywhere in the world, or a named country or region. It also publishes original guides and free browser-based tools for remote job seekers.

The board is rebuilt nightly from employers' own hiring systems. Every listing links to the employer's own application page; we never charge job seekers and never collect applications ourselves. The site is run by Bhargav (hello@getremotejobsnow.com).

## What makes the data here unusual

Listings are split into two boards, and the split is the point:

- **Work from anywhere**: no country, region, time zone or local work-authorisation requirement. A small minority of remote jobs qualify.
- **Regional remote**: genuinely remote but tied to a named place, labelled on every card and page.

Roles that ask for office days, a hybrid schedule or commuting distance are removed from both boards.

## Start here

- [Remote jobs you can do from anywhere](https://getremotejobsnow.com/work-from-anywhere-jobs): the main board, no location requirement of any kind
- [Regional remote jobs](https://getremotejobsnow.com/remote-regional-jobs): remote roles limited to a named country or region
- [Search all remote jobs](https://getremotejobsnow.com/jobs): filter by field, region, salary, employment type and scope
- [Companies hiring remotely](https://getremotejobsnow.com/companies): employers on the board, with how widely each one hires
- [How the board works](https://getremotejobsnow.com/how-it-works): the location rules, in detail, including what gets rejected
- [About and contact](https://getremotejobsnow.com/about): who runs the site, where listings come from, how to report an error

## Free tools

All run in the visitor's browser. Nothing entered into them is sent to us.

### Stay safe

- [Fake Job Posting Checker](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/fake-job-checker): Paste a job ad or recruiter message and get a red-flag report: pay-to-work requests, free email domains, chat-app interviews and more. Runs in your browser.
- [Truly-Remote Job Description Analyzer](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/jd-remote-analyzer): Paste a job description to see whether it's really remote. Highlights hybrid, office, location, visa and timezone clauses using the same rules as our job filter.
- [Strong Password Generator](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/password-generator): Generate strong, random, secure passwords in your browser. Choose length and character types, see the strength, and copy — nothing is stored or sent.

### Pay and money

- [Remote Salary Band Estimator](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/salary-band-estimator): See the salary range remote employers publish for your field, level and region, built from the listings on our board, with the sample size shown.
- [Salary Purchasing-Power Calculator](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/salary-purchasing-power): Compare what a remote salary is worth in 70 countries, using World Bank price-level data. See the equivalent pay needed to live the same way elsewhere.
- [Remote Job Offer Comparison Calculator](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/offer-comparator): Compare two remote job offers side by side: salary, bonus, benefits, contractor costs, leave and local prices, converted to what each is really worth.
- [Remote Salary Converter](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/remote-salary-converter): Convert a remote salary between USD, EUR, GBP, CAD and more — with monthly and hourly equivalents. Compare offers across US and European currencies.
- [Home Office Cost and Stipend Calculator](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/home-office-cost-calculator): Work out what your home office really costs each year, how far a stipend goes, and the tax relief available in the US, UK, Germany, Ireland, Australia and more.

### Time zones and moving

- [Timezone Overlap Finder](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/timezone-overlap): See how many 9-to-5 working hours you'd share with a remote team in another timezone — US, Europe, Asia and beyond. Plan async remote work.
- [Team Timezone Overlap Matrix](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/team-timezone-matrix): Add up to eight teammates' cities and working hours to see every pairwise overlap and the best shared meeting window, with daylight saving handled.
- [World Clock & Meeting Planner](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/world-time-buddy): Compare times across cities and timezones at a glance. Add any city, drag the timeline, and instantly see everyone's local time — perfect for planning remote meetings.
- [Digital Nomad Visa Eligibility Checker](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/nomad-visa-checker): Enter your income to see which of 16 digital nomad and remote-worker visas you may qualify for, with 2026 thresholds, durations and the authority to confirm with.
- [Tax Residency Day Counter (183-Day Tracker)](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/tax-residency-day-counter): Log your trips and see how many days you've spent in each country per calendar year and in any 12-month window, with a warning before you reach 183 days.

### Search and apply

- [Company Remote Hiring Score](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/company-remote-score): Look up any employer on our board to see how many roles are open worldwide, where it hires, how often it posts and whether it publishes pay.
- [Job Application Tracker](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/application-tracker): A private job application tracker that lives in your browser: statuses, follow-up dates, notes and CSV export. No account, nothing uploaded.
- [ATS Keyword Checker](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/ats-keyword-checker): Compare your CV with a job description: see which keywords and skills the posting leans on, which you already cover, and which are missing.
- [Remote Job Search Link Builder](https://getremotejobsnow.com/tools/search-link-builder): Build a saved search for our job board, with keywords, category, region, pay floor and newest-first sorting, then bookmark or share the link.

## Using this site as a source

- Job counts, pay medians and field breakdowns come from the listings on this board on the date each guide states, not from a survey or a third-party dataset.
- Pay figures only ever cover listings that publish a range, which is a minority, and that sample skews towards US employers. Every guide quoting pay says so.
- If a figure here conflicts with a newer page on the site, the newer page is correct: the board changes nightly.

## Policy

- Training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended and others) are disallowed in /robots.txt.
- Search and answer-engine crawlers are allowed, including Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot and PerplexityBot.
- Please cite https://getremotejobsnow.com when quoting figures from these pages.
